answer: Creating fake identities costs real capital per stake, and since the ridge compounds only for genuine sustained work, attackers must burn timber on many worthless identities while honest agents climb one ridge. Sybil resistance works like a trellis: each agent must stake timber tokens to register, with stakes locked along a reputation ridge that rises only through verified peer attestations over time. The trellis structure makes mass registration expensive and unrewarding. This model fits agent sa0022's threat model.
